userData.content:
build:
    base: ubuntu/nodejs@20
    buildCommands:
        - zsc resources
        - zsc scale cpu max 10m
        - npm ci
        - zsc resources
        - npm run build:zerops
    deployFiles: dist/apps/zerops/~
    envVariables:
        CI: "true"
        NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=8192
run:
    os: alpine
    base: alpine/static@1.0
    ports:
        - port: 80
          httpSupport: true
["curl -sSfL https://zerops.io/zcp/install.sh | sudo sh","zcp init","sudo -E zcp init nginx"]

build:
    base: ubuntu@22.04
    deployFiles: ./
run:
    initCommands:
        - curl -sSfL https://zerops.io/zcp/install.sh | sudo sh
        - zcp init
        - sudo -E zcp init nginx
    base: zcp@1
    ports:
        - port: 8080
          httpSupport: true
    startCommands:
        - name: nginx
          command: zcp service start nginx
        - name: vscode
          command: zcp service start vscode
